questions.question:
Three positions of a dice are given below. What will come on the face opposite to the face containing '6' on it?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8c9a1f798e51e7fdfb5609e22051ffa1bbf0bf3d58d0d317538254aa0272937.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of '5', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

Now, number '5' is given in Dice 1 and Dice 3, 

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 3,

When we move in clockwise direction starting from m we get;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b81fbba357dbea2e599e79a946a39f37b71ed38eede6319f367d8d5edcd1e27.png] 

→ 5 is the common surface and 1, 6, 3, 2 is the adjacent surface.

**Opposites sides:**

1 → 3

5 → 4

**6 → 2** 

So, the '2' will be the opposite face of '6'.

Hence, the correct answer is "2".

questions.question: Five persons Anuj, Bheem, Chetan, Dheer and Imran are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only one person is sitting between Chetan and Dheer. Bheem is sitting second to the left of Dheer. Anuj is sitting to the immediate right of Bheem. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Anuj?
questions.solution:
Given: Five persons Anuj, Bheem, Chetan, Dheer and Imran.

1. Only one person is sitting between Chetan and Dheer.

2. Bheem is sitting second to the left of Dheer.

3. Anuj is sitting to the immediate right of Bheem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3603c5979d82908d361c8177b5ff8e011ea019b7a866c7677ac17c2dfd45892b.png] 

So, **Bheem **is sitting to the immediate left of Anuj.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Bheem".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth word in the same way as the fourth word is related to the third word and the second word is related to the first word.

HAWA MAHAL : RAJASTHAN :: CHARMINAR : TELANGANA :: STATUE OF UNITY : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: **Monument to state association.**

Each pair links a famous monument to the state where It is located.

Hawa Mahal is in Rajasthan.

Charminar is in Telangana.

Similarly,

The Statue of Unity is in **Gujarat**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "GUJARAT".**

questions.question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are seated in a straight line and all of them are facing north, but not necessarily in the same order. B sits second to right of F. F sits at one of the extreme ends of the line. Only three people sit between B and E. C sits third to the left of D. Only two people sit between D and A. G is not an immediate neighbour of E. Who is sitting on the immediate left of H?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1. F sits at one of the extreme ends of the line.

2. Only three people sit between B and E.

3. C sits third to the left of D.

4. Only two people sit between D and A.

5. G is not an immediate neighbour of E.

6. B sits second to right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec5da84c12e2627f255d0d8e298bac1a098dcc1163db0aaadcd67718e90df4d1.png] 

So, **D** is sitting on the immediate left of H.

Hence, the correct answer is** "D".**

Option 3) **pqrs **→ p__**p**__qqrrss / ppq__**q**__rrss / ppqqrrss / ppqqr__**r**__s**__s__**

Here, 'ppqqrrss' followed a pattern.

Option 4) prpr → p__p__qqrrss / ppq__r__rrss / ppqqrrss / ppqqr__p__s__r__

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I: **Some books are pens.

**Statement II:** All pens are pencils.

**Statement III:** No pencil is a marker.

**Conclusion I: **Some books are not pens.

**Conclusion II: **No pen is a marker.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given statements:

Some books are pens.

All pens are pencils.

No pencil is a marker.

The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/531644b334c922ff757ed7c2e84f730ac8048b9f18df789b48e95a9e47d7d767.png] 

Conclusion:

I: Some books are not pens. - **False **(Because, Some books are pens given, so some books are not pens it is not possible)

II: No pen is a marker. - **True **(Because, All pens are pencils and No pencil is a marker so No pen is a marker it is definite)

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion II follows".**
